post.description: Creates a new user account. The password is hashed before it is stored.
Returns a short-lived access token in the body. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie and never appears in the body.
Reads the refresh cookie, exchanges it for a new access token and a new refresh cookie (rotation). Reusing an old cookie revokes the whole login.
Revokes the refresh cookie's login and clears the cookie. Always returns 204, so it is safe to call twice.

get.summary: List a stokvel's contributions, one page at a time
get.description: Filters, sorting and paging all run in the database. pageSize defaults to 20 and is capped at 100; sort is recordedAt (default) or amount, prefixed with '-' for descending. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page; an empty nextPageToken means there are no more results. minAmountCents and maxAmountCents filter by amount, in integer cents.

post.description: Records a member's payment for a stokvel cycle. Requires an Idempotency-Key header, and rejects a second contribution from the same member for the same cycle.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh UUID per attempt. Retrying the same request with the same key replays the first result instead of recording twice.

get.description: Returns a single contribution, scoped to this stokvel.
Any member of the stokvel can list its cycles.

post.description: Pays the cycle's total contributions to one member and closes the cycle. Treasurer or Chairperson only.

get.description: The signed-in member: id, email and full name. Never includes the password hash. Their role is not here because a role belongs to one stokvel; /me/home returns it per stokvel.

One card per stokvel the caller belongs to: their role, the current cycle, what they have paid and still owe this cycle (integer cents), and the next payout date (a South African calendar date). currentCycle is an object with its dates (endsOn is the due date), or null when no cycle is open; paid and owed are then 0. An empty list if they belong to none.
Returns the stokvels the signed-in user belongs to.

post.description: Creates a new stokvel. The creator is automatically enrolled as its first member, with the Chairperson role.

get.description: Returns a single stokvel, including its current members and their roles, the member count and its current cycle (null when no cycle is open) with the cents collected and due.

post.summary: Add a member to a stokvel
post.description: Enrolls a user into the stokvel with the given role. Chairperson only. Fails if the user is already a member.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a stokvel
delete.description: Removes the member. Refuses to remove the last admin, so a stokvel always has someone who can run it. Does not delete the member's past contributions.

put.description: Changes a member's role within the stokvel. Refuses a change that would leave the stokvel without an admin.

AccessTokenResponse.description: What the client sees after login or refresh. The refresh token travels only in the cookie.

ContributionResponse.description: A contribution. Money is integer cents; RecordedAt is UTC and ends in Z.

CreateStokvelRequest.description: The contribution amount is integer cents (R500 is 50000).

HomeCurrentCycle.description:
The stokvel's open cycle. EndsOn is the due date. StartsOn and EndsOn are
null only for a cycle created before cycles had dates.

HomeResponse.description:
Exactly what the member home screen shows: one card per stokvel the caller
belongs to. Only the caller's own amounts; no member lists.

HomeStokvelCard.description:
Money is integer cents (exact in JavaScript); dates are South African
calendar dates ("2026-10-31"), not UTC dates.

PagedResponseOfContributionResponse.description:
One page of a list endpoint. NextPageToken is opaque to the client:
pass it back as ?pageToken= to get the next page. An empty string
means this is the last page. No total count, on purpose — counting
would cost an extra COUNT(*) query on every page.

PayoutResponse.description: A payout. Money is integer cents; PaidAt is UTC and ends in Z.

correlationId.description: The reference a member can quote to support. Also written to the server log.

traceId.description: The W3C trace id of the request.

RecordContributionRequest.description:
What the caller sends to record a contribution. StokvelId is
deliberately not a field here — it comes from the route
(POST /api/stokvels/{stokvelId}/contributions) so a client can never
send a body that disagrees with the URL it actually called.
The amount is integer cents (R100.50 is 10050).

StokvelDetailResponse.description:
One stokvel with the numbers its page shows. Money is integer cents; EndsOn is a
South African calendar date. CurrentCycle is null when no cycle is open.

UserResponse.description:
What a User looks like over the wire — deliberately excludes
PasswordHash so it can never leak into a response body.

correlationId.description: The reference a member can quote to support. Also written to the server log.

traceId.description: The W3C trace id of the request.
